title: Lock-free backup target readers misdiagnose an in-flight or just-completed target set as backup_record_unreadable
outcome: Lock-free backup target readers misdiagnose an in-flight or just-completed target set as backup_record_unreadable
acceptance: A target set that completed before the reader's retry configuration read (settled B/B, with no further mutation) is read correctly by the lock-free status readers. A set still in flight across both reads, or repeated changes, may still refuse; that refusal is documented as a bounded-reader limit and its message tells the operator a target set may be in progress and to retry.
A deterministic test reproduces the torn read for at least one of these callers

completion.summary: Fixed lock-free backup target readers by adding a bounded unlocked reread for identity mismatch, with a retry hint for persistent mismatch and documentation. Full gate passed all 12 stages on the frozen tree; the pre-commit evaluation passed 2/2, all six live stores were ready, and the change was fast-forward committed and pushed as e01a046 to origin/master. Installed the matching release build and confirmed installed readiness fingerprint 16ad5e1a4d074a7100b470857dc21f1f2b577fff7a47014270062e326fe154f2. The fresh post-landing evaluation passed 2/2. The prior binary is backed up. Running processes retain their old loaded build until restarted; no restart was performed.
